title: PPSR Core adapter + PPSR Core <-> DwC mapping + external conformance CI gate
context: PLAN v0.2 promotes PPSR Core to a first-class standard alongside Darwin Core because the air/water-quality and phenology projects named in the executive summary are not natively Darwin Core — a DwC-only design silently excludes them. The adapter layer must parse PPSR Core (project/dataset/observation models) and provide a PPSR Core <-> DwC bidirectional mapping so biodiversity and non-biodiversity projects share one pipeline. M1 exit criteria also add an external conformance gate: output validated by GBIF data-validator or Frictionless validate rather than self-asserted. Depends on csp-adapter-007.
objective: Extend @csp/adapter-* to parse PPSR Core project/dataset/observation records into the canonical model, implement a bidirectional PPSR Core <-> DwC mapping, pack outputs as PPSR Core-conformant, and add a CI gate that validates output against an external authority (GBIF data-validator or Frictionless validate) rather than self-assertion.
acceptanceCriteria: Parses PPSR Core (project, dataset, observation models) into the canonical record model; packs outputs as conformant PPSR Core
PPSR Core <-> DwC bidirectional mapping implemented and tested; a non-biodiversity dataset (e.g. air-quality or phenology observations) passes through the pipeline without silent field loss
CI gate validates output conformance against an external authority (GBIF data-validator or Frictionless validate), not by self-assertion alone
Adapter carries license + provenance metadata through to the packaged output per the agent-neutral-core discipline
output: A PR extending @csp/adapter-* with PPSR Core parse-in/pack-out, the PPSR Core <-> DwC bidirectional mapping, and a CI external-conformance gate.
